This addresses only the what of failure; the why and when may go unlogged, allowing the same error to recur across episodes. We propose long-horizon temporal regret alongside outcome regret and epistemic regret. These are diagnostic quantities, not standard comparator-based online-learning regrets. Temporal regret captures how long an unresolved or incorrect causal model is tolerated; epistemic regret captures posterior error over that model.
